scientific_integrity: The full homology character is derived by exact finite cubical chain computations with a rational rank sandwich and an exhaustive signed group action. Known first-homology rank and nonplanar torsion phenomena are excluded from the novelty claim.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary rational homology and complete characters for exactly two unordered particles on the Pappus graph; does not classify integral representation lattices, torsion exponents, braid-group presentations, quotient homotopy types or more particles. This is not an independent validation or certification.
title: Full 216-symmetry homology characters of the two-particle Pappus configuration space
